integrity: Proof is exact for all admissible integers; 3,103,793 independently enumerated digit strings and 117,810 modular tuples are supplementary finite checks, not an infinite certificate. No outside independent validation performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem excludes two highest zero carries, and all zero-padding extensions beyond two precise outer-padding patterns. It does not classify arbitrary derived palintiple constructions or establish sufficiency for the remaining patterns. It is proved independently from first principles but uses and credits classical carry identities. Priority remains subject to unindexed equivalent results.
title: Zero-padding rigidity of reverse-multiple carry strings
